race.comment: OLIVIA MARIE (7) returns for the Oxlade team and looks to have come on a treat during the break. Expecting her to burn across from the wide alley and give them something to catch. SENSATIONAL SECRET (9) wasn't far away when resuming last start, chasing gamely into second. Is sure to have come on from that and is drawn kinder. Bold showing anticipated. FAR MORE RADIANT (5) has run into some handy winners this prep and should find this a bit easier. Gets in light with the 3kg claim and is right in the mix this time. SECRET OWL (8) mixed her form in her debut prep with some sound efforts in the middle. Has jumped out well in readiness, though will need a smart steer from a sticky draw. JUST COMET (6) hit the line well in both runs in her debut prep before spelling. Fitter for a jumpout and is one to keep in mind.
